title: Weekly Radio Show Begins
description: BethGold Foundation's founder starts a weekly advocacy programme on Radio Veritas 102.9FM, then called "Lee Nyu Bookaa." It was rebranded the Disability Radio Talk Show that June, and has run every Saturday since.

title: Officially Registered
description: BethGold Foundation is registered as an NGO under the AG Chambers, Ministry of Justice (Reg. No. 2023/C21573).

title: Advocacy Meeting with KMC Mayor
description: BethGold Foundation's executives meet with the Mayor of the Kanifing Municipal Council to advance a partnership on disability-inclusive treatment, education, and media outreach.

title: Honoring Community Advocates
description: BethGold Foundation publicly celebrates advocate Cherno Ceesay, including his Patriotic Citizens Award 2023 from the Coaches of Influence Foundation (COIF).

title: Discovery Awards 3.0 Launches
description: BethGold Foundation promotes the launch of Discovery Awards 3.0, a collaboration between EnAble India and Zero Project recognizing low-cost assistive solutions from a 29-country network.

title: Appointed Discovery Award Africa Regional Coordinator
description: EnAble India appoints BethGold Foundation to coordinate and mobilize country partners across Africa for the Discovery Awards — now an annual partnership.

title: Rolls & Walks 2.0
description: BethGold Foundation partners with the Remembering Reuel Foundation on a disability inclusion event for 400+ students and 100 adults across 26+ Gambian schools.
_NOTE: Unconfirmed whether this is an annual event or a one-off — description deliberately doesn't state either way.
